name: The Hollow
desc:
There is no official record of ‘The Hollow.’
How long it has existed is unknown.
Its exact location is unclear.

We are asking you not to go in.

If you decide to go in anyway, please be advised: 

We cannot say where you will end up each night. 
You may think you know where you are.
You may recognize what is waiting for you. 
None of it should be there.

Some creators are going in live. 
We could not stop them.
They may need your help.

Other games may be connected to The Hollow. 
What you find there can help you inside.

If you are still there on October 31, you will not be the only one trying to get out. 
And not everyone will.

We cannot keep it closed. We cannot keep it closed. We cannot keep it closed. We cannot keep it closed. We cannot keep it closed. We cannot keep it closed. We cannot keep it closed. We cannot keep it closed. We cannot keep it closed. We cannot keep it closed. We cannot keep it closed. We cannot keep it closed. We cannot keep it closed.

llm.loop: enter The Hollow each night -> explore a horror location -> find items linked from other games -> help creators -> survive to the Oct 31 finale
llm.objectives: survive The Hollow and escape on Oct 31
llm.progression: nights, badges, items from connected games
llm.instructions: Mysterious ARG-style text; connected games help you inside
unique: Roblox-run cross-game Halloween event with live creators
